attempts.prompt:
Create one production sprite atlas for a French fan-made Mass Effect RPG with HD 2D creature sprites in Three.js 3D environments. Exactly eight separate complete creatures, a clean 4-column by 2-row layout on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, wide transparent gutters and at least 24px padding from every cell edge. Landscape 1536x1024. No text, no labels, no frame borders, no scenery, no ground tiles, no cast ground shadows or glow. Every body, jaw, toe, antenna and tail stays fully inside its own cell. Three-quarter view facing slightly left, realistic game creature anatomy, detailed pre-rendered HD materials, soft consistent upper-left lighting, muted natural science-fiction colours. Not pixel art, not cute chibi, not humans in costumes. Each is one still idle/alert body.
Top row left to right:
1. Mass Effect 1 ordinary Varren from the Feros tunnels: squat muscular four-legged alien predator, broad low tooth-lined reptilian jaw, leathery grey-green scaled skin, short strong hindquarters, low shoulder ridge, sturdy clawed feet, no saddle, no weapons, complete body.
2. Mass Effect 1 Feros Alpha Varren: the same recognisable quadruped Varren family but visibly larger/heavier shoulder and head silhouette, darker olive and rusty-red scaled ridges, broad heavy tooth-lined jaw, grounded four-footed alert posture. Not an extra species, no horns or armour equipment, no magic.
3. Harmless Mass Effect 1 Eden Prime gasbag wildlife: a small pale peach-orange translucent inflated ovoid gas sac with a narrow dark lower stem and a few fine dangling organic tendrils, gently hovering, no angry mouth, no weapon, no smoke or background effect. Read as placid alien balloon fauna.
4. Mass Effect 2 Varren: stocky four-legged alien predator of the Varren family, cool grey-blue and dusty ochre reptilian hide, broad bulldog-like toothed jaw and low ridged back, grounded side-three-quarter stance, no collar or saddle. Keep distinct from the ME1 ordinary Varren.
Bottom row left to right:
5. Mass Effect 2 Tuchanka Pyjak: small wiry grey-brown alien monkey-like quadruped, sparse dusty fur, leathery expressive face, big alert eyes, four long limbs and one fully visible curled long tail, crouched alert but not attacking, no clothes or accessories.
6. Mass Effect 1 Thresher Maw / Dévoreur: a gigantic subterranean segmented worm represented as one complete visible emerging upper body tapering into a curling narrow lower coil, purple-brown plated chitin, large articulated mouth/mandibles and swept-back organic spines, no humanoid arms or legs, no wings, no ground or dust. A dossier silhouette only, all appendages contained.
7. Mass Effect Andromeda wild Adhi: lean powerful hostile-looking alien quadruped with brown-grey plated reptilian skin, elongated toothy jaw, strong hind legs, angular bony shoulder/back plates and a long tapered tail, complete neutral stalking body, no kett implants or armour, no saddle.
8. Mass Effect Andromeda Kaerkyn: low broad heavily armoured crab/scarab-like alien wildlife with warm sand-orange and stone-grey ridged chitin, stout articulated legs, a compact head and paired mandible-like mouthparts, defensive grounded neutral stance, no scorpion tail, no weapons or implants. Distinct low armoured silhouette from all quadruped dog-like creatures.
These are partial prototype interpretations, prioritize full clean separated bodies with consistent material rendering and no cropped limbs. Maintain native transparent output.
